title: Grateful Dead Live at Frost Amphitheatre on 1982-10-09

ai_review.summary: Crisp soundboard captures a high‑energy 1982 set with a smoking Truckin’ > Other One > Dew sequence and standout Throwing Stones/Touch of Grey opener.
ai_review.review: The recording is an excellent soundboard source—clear, balanced, and virtually free of drop‑outs. The show itself erupts from start to finish, highlighted by a monster Truckin’ → Other One → Dew stretch, a fiery Throwing Stones into Touch of Grey opener, and powerful Estimated → Eyes and Drums → Space jams. Reviewers consistently praise the tight playing, soaring energy, and memorable moments despite a few minor lyrical slips.

ai_rating.rationale: Overwhelmingly positive reviews (mostly 5‑star) praise both performance and sound quality; only a handful of moderate comments lower the average slightly.

recording_quality.technical_notes: Reviewers describe the mix as crisp, balanced, with occasional minor drop‑outs late in the show but overall superb clarity.

standout_songs: Truckin' > The Other One > Wharf Rat (Dew)
poor_songs: Music Never Stopped (unfocused according to one reviewer)
show_quality.setlist_flow: Tight, well‑sequenced set with strong transitions—especially the Throwing Stones/Touch opener and the second‑set monster jams.

band_member_comments.Jerry: Garcia's guitar tone praised as “smarmy Dylan” and “effortless”; his vocals noted as passionate though a few lyrical flubs on Touch of Grey.
band_member_comments.Phil: Phil’s bass is described as “bombs flying everywhere,” full‑avant‑garde mode, providing powerful low‑end drive.
band_member_comments.Bob: Weir’s rhythm guitar/vocals get mixed remarks—some lyric quirks and neologisms but overall solid; a "Swiss watch" timing comment appears.
band_member_comments.Keys: Brent (keyboards) noted for strong vocal contributions on Deal and occasional desire for more keyboard presence in the mix.
band_member_comments.Drums: Bill and Mickey’s drumming praised as strong, especially the Drums → Space segment described as “unbelievable” and “primal.”
